summary: Explicit ownership decisions for EUDI wallet obligations that sit at or near the Wallet boundary. Wallet keeps this contract and its local evidence; Identity Taxonomy may mirror ownership and coverage, and Identity Conformance records composed runs.

areas.wallet_responsibility: Wallet Unit lifecycle states, transitions, trusted-time evidence bounds, and authenticated authority for every event after initial provisioning begins.

Authenticated status-list application, terminal revoked and deleted states, and refusal to release presentation copies for inactive credentials. Refresh scheduling is a host responsibility. The public protobuf status-evidence operation is disabled, so status updates go through the Rust inventory API only.
Wallet Unit and WSCD revocation state, including the attestation status reference and the resulting lifecycle restriction.
Retention limits, user-initiated deletion of log entries, and notice before pruning, consistent with the hash-chained history.
Authorization, lifecycle evidence, and record meaning for backup, restore, export, and migration. The migration package content policy is not yet defined.
Attestation type and PID, QEAA, PuB-EAA, or EAA category on credential records wherever the category changes a Wallet decision such as reuse, reissuance, or portability.
Wallet verifies, binds, and rotates Wallet Unit Attestations through injected providers. Acquiring Wallet Instance and key attestations from the Wallet Provider stays outside Wallet.
Wallet supplies reader-session consent receipts and contact-delivery framing. ISO/IEC 18013-5 transports and Digital Credentials API integration stay outside Wallet.

User-facing data-deletion requests to relying parties, reports to data protection authorities, and dashboard workflows stay outside Wallet. Durable rights-request records remain the open rights-request-records item in the reference-code review.
Wallet defines authorization and record meaning; VaultWallet owns the storage mechanics for authorized backup and migration.
No Wallet support is claimed until product scope is decided.
